ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 (white-to-black ratio); the surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels with a high frequency of high-intensity localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Non-contiguous distribution of high-intensity white circular clusters across a primary dark substrate; clusters are densest in the medial and outer lateral regions of both lobes, with no large-scale (>15% surface area) solid pigmentation banding visible.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 64 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the lateral thirds of the trailing edge, ranging from 2 to 12 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on both the left and right lobes extending from the central notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (5-20 pixels in diameter) across approximately 45% of the visible fluke area, representing dense focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear disruption (white pixel path) on the lower inner quadrant of the left lobe; several finer, unaligned horizontal linear marks on the lower right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive non-pigmented surface scarring across both lobes; no major amputations or physical structural trauma to the lobe boundaries identified.
other_distinctive_markers: The lateral tips of the flukes exhibit highly irregular, jagged geometry, with the right tip showing more pronounced step-like pixel variations than the left.
